description:
This PHP source file defines the 'Customer' report model in the OpenCart admin system. It provides methods to retrieve various customer-related statistics and data, such as counts by time periods, customer details, orders, reward points, activities, and searches. The class interacts with the database using SQL queries and is designed to be loaded within the OpenCart framework.

It extends the core Model class and is part of the namespace 'Opencart\Admin\Model\Extension\Opencart\Report'.

classes.name: Customer
classes.description: A model class in the OpenCart system responsible for generating customer reports, including counts, details, activities, and searches, based on various filters and timeframes.

methods.name: getTotalCustomersByDay
methods.description: Retrieves the total number of customers added for each hour of the current day.

methods.name: getTotalCustomersByWeek
methods.description: Retrieves the total number of customers added each day of the current week.

methods.name: getTotalCustomersByMonth
methods.description: Retrieves the total number of customers added each day of the current month.

methods.name: getTotalCustomersByYear
methods.description: Retrieves the total number of customers added each month of the current year.

methods.name: getCustomers
methods.description: Fetches customer records with optional time frame and grouping filters, returning basic customer info and stats.

methods.name: getTotalCustomers
methods.description: Returns the total count of distinct customer entries, optionally filtered by date range and group.

methods.name: getOrders
methods.description: Retrieves order data associated with customers, including order counts, totals, and product quantities, with filtering options.

methods.name: getTotalOrders
methods.description: Counts the total number of customer orders, with optional filters.

methods.name: getRewardPoints
methods.description: Fetches reward point data for customers, including total points, associated orders, and totals.

methods.name: getTotalRewardPoints
methods.description: Returns the total number of reward point records, with optional filtering.

methods.name: getCustomerActivities
methods.description: Retrieves activity logs related to customer actions, filtered by date range, customer, or IP.

methods.name: getTotalCustomerActivities
methods.description: Counts total customer activity records based on filters.

methods.name: getCustomerSearches
methods.description: Fetches customer search keyword data, including filters for date, keyword, customer, and IP.

methods.name: getTotalCustomerSearches
methods.description: Counts total customer search records matching the provided filters.
